lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Responsibilities If Stopped by Law Enforcement
prompt: What should a driver do immediately after stopping for an officer during a nighttime traffic stop?

options.text: Exit the vehicle immediately and walk toward the patrol cruiser quickly
Turn on interior dome light, roll down driver window, place hands on steering wheel
Reach under passenger seats to search for insurance cards before officer arrives
Rev the engine slightly to verify alternator voltage is charging battery
